title: 9 משחקים וספרים לגילאי 3-4 שיעזרו להם לחכות לתור

stage.need: Waiting for a turn and playing alongside other children. CDC lists at 4 years the tips to teach a child to stop and wait by playing games such as red light, green light, to take turns copying each other's moves and to play simple games; at 3 years children notice other children and join them to play; at 5 years the milestone is following rules or taking turns when playing games with other children. HealthyChildren (3 to 4) lists cooperating and sharing. The games give a playful reason to wait, the books give characters who wait and make room for others (an opportunity to practise, not a guarantee).
stage.age_caveat: Ages are approximate: CDC lists taking turns as a milestone at 5 years, not 3 or 4, and milestones are what most children do by an age, not a deadline. Many 3 and 4 year olds find waiting hard and learn it with practice at their own pace. The caption says so (בערך, יש ילדים ש...). All four books carry Sifriyat Pijama's younger kindergarten label, Preschool (3-5).

dev_sources.title: Milestones by 3 Years
dev_sources.publisher: CDC, Learn the Signs. Act Early.
dev_sources.quote: Notices other children and joins them to play ... Matching games: Ask your child to find matching objects in books or around the house.
dev_sources.supports: At 3 years children notice other children and join them to play (the social milestone), and the page suggests simple matching games. It does not list taking turns as a 3-year milestone. Milestones are what most children do by an age, not a deadline.

dev_sources.title: Milestones by 4 Years
dev_sources.publisher: CDC, Learn the Signs. Act Early.
dev_sources.quote: Teach your child to stop and wait when excited by playing red light, green light, or freeze dance ... Play your child's favorite songs and dance with your child. Take turns copying each other's moves. ... Play simple games, such as Tic-Tac-Toe or matching games. ... Says some words from a song, story, or nursery rhyme ... Tells what comes next in a well-known story
dev_sources.supports: At 4 years the tips are to teach a child to stop and wait by playing games, to take turns copying each other's moves and to play simple games; the language milestones include saying words from a song, story or nursery rhyme and telling what comes next in a well-known story. Tips are general advice; milestones are what most children do by an age.

dev_sources.title: Milestones by 5 Years
dev_sources.publisher: CDC, Learn the Signs. Act Early.
dev_sources.quote: Follows rules or takes turns when playing games with other children ... Teach your child to follow rules in games. For example, play simple board games, card games, or Simon Says. ... Uses or recognizes simple rhymes (bat-cat, ball-tall) ... Names some letters when you point to them ... Writes some letters in her name ... Answers simple questions about a book or story after you read or tell it to him ... Play rhyming games. For example, say "What rhymes with cat?"
dev_sources.supports: At 5 years CDC lists following rules or taking turns in games with other children, using or recognising simple rhymes, naming some letters and writing some letters in the child's name, answering simple questions about a story, and tips to play simple board and card games and rhyming games. Milestones are what most children (75 percent or more) do by an age.

dev_sources.title: Developmental Milestones: 3 to 4 Year Olds
dev_sources.publisher: HealthyChildren.org, American Academy of Pediatrics (last updated 4 Apr 2023)
dev_sources.quote: Cooperates with other children and shares ... They're also starting to interact more with other children.
dev_sources.supports: Children of 3 to 4 are starting to interact more with other children, and cooperating and sharing is listed as a social milestone. The page does not mention taking turns or waiting.

ספרו בתגובות

caption:
משחקים וספרים שבהם הילדים מתרגלים לחכות לתור
יש ילדים שמחכים בקלות כבר בגיל 3 ויש שצריכים עוד זמן
איזה משחק הילדים שלכם מבקשים שוב ושוב?

claims.wording_he: משחקים וספרים שיעזרו להם לחכות לתור
claims.supports: CDC 4 years: teach your child to stop and wait by playing games, take turns copying each other's moves, play simple games; CDC 5 years: follows rules or takes turns when playing games with other children; HealthyChildren 3 to 4: cooperates and shares. "Help them wait for a turn" is an opportunity to practise, not a promised result.

claims.wording_he: בערך בגיל 4 ילדים מתרגלים לעצור ולחכות לתור של אחרים
claims.supports: CDC 4 years tip: teach your child to stop and wait when excited by playing red light, green light or freeze dance; CDC 3 years: notices other children and joins them to play; HealthyChildren 3 to 4: starting to interact more with other children. CDC lists taking turns as a 5-year milestone, so the caption says some children need more time.

claims.wording_he: משחקים ביחד וספרים על המתנה מאפשרים להם לתרגל את זה
claims.supports: CDC 4 years: play simple games and take turns copying each other's moves; CDC 5 years: play simple board games and card games to follow rules. "An opportunity to practise" is our wording.

claims.wording_he: מתרגלים להניח חלק רק בתורם ולחכות לתור של השני
claims.supports: Center Toys description: in your turn place the piece that matches the die; CDC 4 years: stop and wait by playing games; CDC 5 years: takes turns when playing games.

claims.wording_he: מתרגלים לשמוע מה כל חבר רוצה ולחכות לתור שלו
claims.supports: Sifriyat Pijama blurb: each friend asks for something before the story can start; CDC 4 years: stop and wait; HealthyChildren 3 to 4: cooperates and shares.

claims.wording_he: מתרגלים לחכות לתור ולשלוף צוללת בלי לגעת בנחשים
claims.supports: Center Toys, Kodkod's text: each player in turn rolls the die and picks a submarine with the tweezers; CDC 4 years: stop and wait; CDC 5 years: takes turns.

claims.wording_he: מתרגלים לחכות עם העכבר עד שהתפוח מבשיל
claims.supports: Sifriyat Pijama: patience, how long it takes the apple to ripen; CDC 4 years: teach your child to stop and wait. Patience is close to waiting for a turn.

claims.wording_he: מתרגלים להטיל קובייה בתורם ולחכות עד שהשחקן הבא מסיים
claims.supports: Foxmind game for 2 to 4 players; the roll-and-move turn rule is from the rules summary of Tricky Track on tarsasjatekok.com (read 2026-10-16); CDC 5 years: play simple board games to follow rules; CDC 4 years: stop and wait.

claims.wording_he: מתרגלים לחכות ולפנות מקום לאחרים ברכבת
claims.supports: Sifriyat Pijama: a crocodile takes a whole carriage and has to think about the people around him; HealthyChildren 3 to 4: cooperates and shares.

claims.wording_he: מתרגלים לחכות לתור גם כשאריח מיוחד מדלג על תור
claims.supports: Bug, Foxmind's text: an angry crocodile tile skips a turn; CDC 5 years: takes turns when playing games.

claims.wording_he: סיפור מותאם אישית עם תמונות של הילדים שלכם
claims.supports: Live site, 2026-10-16: upload a photo of the child and add the name; the name is in the text and the child stars in every illustration.

claims.wording_he: שבו הם פותחים ארגז צעצועים ומגלים שכיף יותר לשתף
claims.supports: Catalogue book 50 (lumebook.com/IL/he/books/50 and api/book/50, read 2026-10-16): the child has a special toy box, a friend comes to play, the child shares the car and the robot and finds that sharing makes everything better.

claims.wording_he: מתרגלים לחכות רגע לפני שמתרגזים כמו הלל
claims.supports: Sifriyat Pijama: Hillel stays calm when two friends ask annoying questions; CDC 4 years: teach your child to stop and wait.

notes: Slot 2 of the 2026-10-18 weekly batch, second of two carousels (format mixed2). Draw: 9 suggestions (4 games, 4 books and the LumeBook book). Order G B G B G B G L B. Different age range and no product shared with the first carousel. Sifriyat Pijama picks are 2011 to 2026; every product is in stock at an Israeli retailer read on 2026-10-16 except Bug (listed or temporarily out of stock).
